properties.name: -webkit-app-region
properties.description: Electron/Chromium-specific property that designates a window drag region. 'drag' makes the element act as a title-bar drag target; 'no-drag' excludes interactive children from dragging.

values.name: drag
values.description: This element becomes a window drag handle.

values.name: no-drag
values.description: Exclude this element from drag behavior.

properties.name: -webkit-user-drag
properties.description: Chromium/Safari-specific property that controls whether an element can be dragged as a native drag operation (e.g. dragging an image to the desktop).

values.name: element
values.description: Only the element itself is draggable.

properties.name: -webkit-overflow-scrolling
properties.description: Legacy iOS Safari momentum-based scrolling. Deprecated since iOS 13 — modern iOS uses momentum scrolling by default. Retained in mdui vendor CSS for backward compatibility.

values.name: touch
values.description: Enable momentum-based scrolling (legacy, now default on iOS 13+).
